note: Adapted from the species-level description in Chhotani (1997); the alate is marked Unknown in the original, hence no such section; major and minor soldiers are treated in a single section; the maximum head width/length ratio and the maximum postmental width of the major soldier appear in the original OCR as 0.BO-0.B3, and those two measurements are not recorded; literature citations, figure numbers and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldiers dimorphic: major soldier body length 9.0–9.6 mm, mandibles thick and falcate, length 1.60–1.70 mm, less than half the head length; minor soldier body length 5.0–5.5 mm, mandibles slender, length 1.20–1.25 mm, more than half the head length. In soldiers the compound eyes and ocelli are reduced; antennae 17-segmented in the major soldier and 16-segmented in the minor soldier.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Major soldier: head capsule yellowish brown, with two brown longitudinal bands, paler around the fontanelle, frons and postclypeus slightly darker; labrum brownish, apex translucent; mandibles black, brownish at the base; antennae brown, paler at the base; thorax pale brown to brown; legs yellow; dorsal abdomen brown, ventral surface paler. Cephalic and thoracic pilosity sparse, abdominal pilosity moderate. Body length 9.0–9.6 mm. Head capsule large, subquadrate, weakly narrowed anteriorly (length to mandibular base 3.50–3.90 mm, maximum width 2.85–3.0 mm), longer than wide. Fontanelle minute, circular, with a brown chitinous ring, leading into a small tube, situated slightly in front of the middle of the head. Compound eyes whitish, circular and flat (diameter 0.05 mm). Ocelli dot-like, reduced. Antennae 17-segmented; segment 3 longer than segment 2; segment 4 nearly as long as segment 2; segment 5 shortest, slightly shorter than segment 4. Labrum nearly triangular, with a sharp translucent point at the apex; widest at the base (length 0.65–0.75 mm, width 0.63–0.65 mm). Mandibles thick, falcate, less than half the head length (length 1.60–1.70 mm, ratio to head length 0.43–0.47). Left mandible with tooth processes on the basal two-thirds; right mandible smooth, without tooth processes. Postmentum subquadrate, long and weakly narrowed at the middle of the posterior part (length 2.5–2.63 mm, waist width 0.55–0.60 mm). Pronotum weakly saddle-shaped, anterior lobe slightly raised (length 1.0–1.13 mm, maximum width 1.78–2.03 mm); anterior margin distinctly incised; posterior margin convex, incurved at the middle. Mesonotum distinctly narrower than pronotum, metanotum slightly narrower; posterior margin of the former weakly incurved, that of the latter nearly straight; lateral margins of both angular and slightly acute. Minor soldier: colour of head capsule, labrum and legs as in the major soldier; mandibles reddish brown, paler at the base; body paler than head capsule. Body length 5.0–5.5 mm. Head capsule subquadrate (maximum width 1.45–1.57 mm, width/length ratio 0.79–0.80); sides weakly convex, anterior quarter narrowed anteriorly. Fontanelle as in the major soldier but smaller, situated behind the middle of the head. Compound eyes and ocelli as in the major soldier, compound eyes slightly smaller (0.025–0.037 mm). Antennae 16-segmented; segment 3 shorter than segment 2; segment 4 nearly as long as segment 3. Labrum as in the major soldier (length 0.45 mm, width 0.38 mm). Mandibles slender, falcate, apex weakly incurved, more than half the head length (length 1.20–1.25 mm, ratio to head length 0.63–0.64). Postmentum subquadrate and without a waist, sides nearly straight. Thorax, legs and abdomen as in the major soldier; pronotum length 0.63–0.72 mm, width 1.0–1.10 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish brown, frons slightly paler; postclypeus paler than head; antennae pale brown; thorax and dorsal abdomen paler than head, ventral abdomen still paler; legs yellow. Cephalic and body pilosity moderate. Body length 4.5–5.0 mm. Head capsule subcircular (length to mandibular base 1.50–1.75 mm, maximum width 1.70–1.75 mm); sides weakly narrowed posteriorly; dorsum slightly raised at the anterior fontanelle and depressed behind it. Fontanellar plate circular (diameter 0.08 mm), situated slightly behind the middle. Compound eyes small, circular, reduced (diameter 0.05 mm). Ocelli small, dot-like. Antennae 17-segmented; segment 3 shorter than segment 2 and nearly as long as segment 4; segment 5 shortest. Postclypeus inflated, pilose, incompletely divided by a median line; length less than half its width. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, anterior lobe strongly upturned (length 0.48–0.53 mm, maximum width 0.88–0.93 mm); anterior margin weakly incised, posterior margin weakly incurved. Mesonotum narrower than pronotum, metanotum wider than pronotum; posterior margin of the former weakly incurved, that of the latter nearly straight; lateral margins of both rounded.
